'''Chaeldar''' is a mid-level [[Slayer master]]. She is found in the throne room of [[Zanaris]], directly south of the entrance from the [[Lumbridge Swamp]], meaning completion of the [[Lost City]] [[quest]] is required to reach her. She gives out mid to high level [[Slayer]] [[Slayer task|tasks]], which may only be attempted by players with a [[combat level]] of at least 70.

Getting a Slayer task from Chaeldar is a task in the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Medium Diary]].

Blocking a task with Chaeldar costs 70 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Slayer points==
Players can receive [[Slayer reward point]]s for completing [[Slayer task]]s—this is based on how many tasks players have accomplished in a row. Completion of a task assigned by Chaeldar will grant you:

==Fairy rings==
The [[Fairy ring]] network is a useful method of doing Chaeldar's [[Slayer task]]s. It has teleport spots close to the [[Slayer Tower]] ({{Fairycode|CKS}}), the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] ({{Fairycode|AJR}}), and [[Fairy ring|other locations]] to be reached easily for no cost to the player, all of which contain the [[Slayer monster]]s that she assigns and can be easily reached from the fairy ring in [[Zanaris]].

'''Konar quo Maten''' (translated as '''Konar the Hunter''') is a [[Slayer master]] who is found in the [[Kahlith]] settlement on the summit of [[Mount Karuulm]]. Players must have a [[combat level]] of at least 75 to be assigned a [[Slayer task]] from her.

Compared to other Slayer masters, Konar assigns [[wyrm]]s and [[drake]]s more frequently and in higher amounts. She and [[Mortimer]] are the only Slayer Masters who can assign [[hydra]]s as a slayer task. Additionally, she is the only Slayer master who can assign the [[Alchemical Hydra]] as a boss task.

Blocking a task with Konar costs 80 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Slayer points==
Players can receive [[Slayer reward point]]s for completing [[Slayer task]]s—this is based on how many tasks players have accomplished in a row. Completion of a task assigned by Konar will grant players a varying amount of points, depending if they have completed the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary]]. Although she is the third highest Slayer master, she gives the second highest slayer point reward per task due to requiring players to slay in a specific area. The only Slayer master who gives more points is [[Krystilia]], who gives Slayer tasks in the [[Wilderness]].

==Tasks==
Unlike other Slayer masters, Konar's [[Slayer task]]s also include a specific location where players must complete the entire task. 

After a task has been rolled, a second roll is made to determine the location in which Konar wants the player to complete their assignment. This second roll will check any other additional requirements if a location is locked behind a quest. If the player has not completed the quest that unlocks the respective area, then the task will never be directed there; e.g. a player who has not completed [[Song of the Elves]] would not be offered [[waterfiend]]s at the [[Iorwerth Dungeon]], whereas one who did would have that as a potential location. The chance of being assigned a specific location is equal for each eligible location,{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1621613665072910337|date=3 February 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101215|archivedate=4 February 2023|quote=Yes, it's an equal chance for each of the areas you're eligible to access.}} barring the [[Wilderness]] unless it is part of a boss task (e.g. [[Vet'ion]] task), since [[Krystilia]] specializes in that area.

Bosses that are part of the slayer task area can be killed if offered. For example, being assigned [[abyssal demon]]s in the [[Abyss]] means that the [[Abyssal Sire]] may be killed instead, but if the demons were assigned at the [[Catacombs of Kourend]], the Sire would not be an eligible option. Konar will not be able to assign special locations, such as the ability to kill [[Tormented Demon]]s as part of a [[greater demon]] assignment, since greater demons aren't found in the [[Ancient Guthixian Temple]]. Due to this, players who are seeking to kill variants of monsters are recommended to use [[Duradel]] instead.

In return for killing the assigned monsters at the location Konar specifies, players have a chance of receiving a [[brimstone key]], which can be used to open the [[brimstone chest]] next to her.

Lastly, the [[Slayer cape]] perk gives a 10% chance to be reassigned the same monster for a player's task, including the same location.

'''Krystilia''' is a [[Slayer master]] found in [[Edgeville]]'s jail north-east of the [[bank]]. When spoken to, she expresses her love for [[magic]], the Wilderness, and arts and crafts, and claims the guards locked her in the cell for trouble-making.

Players can speak to her to change their [[respawn]] point to Edgeville for a one-time fee of 5,000,000 [[coins]].

Blocking a task with Krystilia costs 100 [[Slayer reward point|Slayer reward points]].

==Slayer==
Krystilia is a Slayer master who assigns the player [[monsters]] found within the [[Wilderness]]. '''Only''' kills within the Wilderness count towards her tasks. Before being assigned a Wilderness task, she will warn you that she will assign '''any''' monster regardless of your combat level.

She will refuse to assign tasks to players who are still Level 1 in Slayer, insisting that they first need to speak to the [[Burthorpe]] Slayer Master [[Turael]] so that he teaches the player about the how the skill works. One good way to get around this is by doing the [[Natural history quiz]] at the Varrock Museum, which will give 1,000 XP both in Slayer and in [[Hunter]], bringing both skills to Level 9, assuming both were at Level 1.

Unlike other slayer masters, Krystilia's tasks have a separate counter from the normal slayer masters, thus players must complete five tasks from her to begin their Wilderness point streak. Despite using two different counters, players '''cannot''' have both a normal and Wilderness slayer task at the same time. However, if the player is given a task they do not want and cannot skip it, they can go to [[Turael]] to remove it (provided that he cannot assign it), though this will remove the Wilderness task streak and require players to complete another five tasks from her to start gaining points again.

For a kill to count towards a Krystilia task, the player must be physically located inside the Wilderness when the monster's death occurs. A player who is using a [[dwarf multicannon]] will receive the standard "As your slayer task is from Krystilia, you can only perform it inside the Wilderness" message if they teleport out of the Wilderness to restock and remain outside of it when their cannon kills the monster. The safe zone buffer immediately outside the [[Ferox Enclave]] counts as the Wilderness for task purposes, but the Enclave itself does not. Thus a player using the [[pool of refreshment]] to resupply will not receive credit for the kill if they are inside the Enclave. 

In return for completing her tasks in the Wilderness, players will have a chance to roll for [[Larran's key]] and [[Slayer's enchantment]] drops. Due to the nature of the Wilderness and the varying location(s) of the assigned monster(s), it is recommended that players do not bring items they are not willing to lose, as it is possible to be killed at any time from other players. She also awards significantly more slayer points than any other master.

Mortimer.wikitext:
{{confuse|Malignius Mortifer}} {{HasStrategy}} {{Infobox NPC |name = Mortimer |image = [[File:Mortimer.png|120px]] |release = [[29 July]] [[2026]] |update = Wyrmscraig Is Out Today! |members = Yes |race = [[Skeleton]] |location = [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]] |shop = [[Slayer Equipment (shop)|Slayer Equipment]], [[Slayer Rewards]] |gender = Male |options = Talk-to, Assignment, Trade, Rewards |examine = He looks dangerous, and boney! |map = {{Map|x=2589|y=8614|plane=0|r=4|mapID=-1|mtype=pin}} |id = 16175,16294 }} [[File:Mortimer chathead.png|left]] '''Mortimer''' is the highest level [[Slayer Master]], found in [[Wyrmscraig Cavern]]. To be assigned a [[Slayer task]] by Mortimer, the player must either have a [[combat level]] of 100 and a [[Slayer]] level of 70, or any combat level if the player has achieved 99 Slayer and shows him the [[Slayer cape]]. In addition, the player must have partially completed the [[Fallen From Grace]] quest. Mortimer has three unique traits that separate him from other Slayer Masters. The first is that, rather than granting [[Slayer point]]s by default, Mortimer has a unique system of unlockable modifiers called "Mortifiers" that affect his tasks. The second is that he only assigns tasks with a [[superior slayer monster|superior]] variant, making him ideal for players seeking drops from the superior slayer table such as the [[imbued heart]] and [[eternal gem]]. The third is that he offers a choice of tasks when getting an assignment from him. Because of this, skipping a task from Mortimer is significantly more expensive, costing 100 slayer points rather than the usual 30, and he only offers two block slots which cost 120 slayer points each. Additionally, Mortimer's tasks '''cannot be skipped''' by receiving a replacement assignment from [[Turael]]. As with [[Krystilia]], tasks stored from Mortimer are shared alongside the rest of the Slayer Masters. The player should take note of this if they have a temporarily undesirable task from Mortimer and another undesirable task from another Slayer Master, as they will be forced to complete one of the two in order to free up storage. Mortimer is the only Slayer Master who can assign [[venator]]s directly, and shares several tasks that used to be exclusive to only a single other Slayer Master, namely [[hydra]]s from [[Konar quo Maten|Konar]], [[infernal mage]]s from [[Vannaka]], and [[rockslug]]s from [[Mazchna]]. While Mortimer is intended for superior slayer monsters, players can complete the task at their corresponding boss if applicable. ==Tasks== [[File:Mortimer Options.png|right|thumb|The interface when selecting an assignment from Mortimer with at least 50 tasks completed, showcasing three tasks to choose from with different modifiers.]] Unlike other [[Slayer Master]]s, Mortimer offers a choice of two potential tasks when approached for an assignment. This increases to three options after the player has completed 50 Slayer tasks with him. Each task can only be offered once per prompt. For example, a player cannot be given a choice of tasks in which two or more options are [[crawling hand]]s. However, players can get the same monster back-to-back, even without the [[slayer cape]] effect going off. Similarly to [[Krystilia]], Mortimer's task streaks are counted separately from that of normal tasks. If Mortimer has offered you a task, you cannot get a task from another Slayer Master. If you attempt to do so, you will receive the message, "Hmm... It appears as though Mortimer has provided you with a task choice, you must go to them in order to pick." Alongside the option to pick a task, each of Mortimer's tasks have a modifier to potentially incentivise one task over another. A modifier can be applied to one or more offered tasks at a time. For example, two tasks might offer more Slayer experience while the third offers a quantity modifier. {| class="wikitable" |+ !Tasks Completed ! colspan="2" |Task Modifier |- |0 |Slayer Point Modifier |Task awards a number of [[Slayer reward point]]s upon completion. Points awarded are dependent on task, with lower slayer level monsters awarding fewer points. When completing a task with this modifier as Partner Slayer, both players obtain the same amount of points, since his original points value is 0. If the contribution ratio is notably different the higher contributor may get an additional slayer point. |- |0 |Task Quantity Modifier |Task modifies amount of slayer creatures assigned. Modifier is dependent on task, with lower slayer level monsters having a reduced quantity and higher level monsters having an increased quantity. eg. If task is for Abyssal Demons 200 - 250, and modifier adds 75 additional kills, your task could range from 275 - 325 kills. |- |15 |Clue Scroll Modifier |[[Clue scroll]] drop rates are increased. |- |25 |Superior Drop Rate Modifier |Task modifies how often [[Superior slayer monster|Superior slayer creatures]] access their '''Superior Slayer tertiary''' drop table. |- |40 |Slayer XP Modifier |Slayer creatures award more Slayer experience. Note that the experience modifier applies to both the Slayer creature as well as their superiors. |- |50 |Third Task Choice |Adds a third choice for task selection during new slayer assignment from Mortimer. |} The Slayer cape, if it activates on one of Mortimer's tasks, will retain the assigned task and modifier. This can be used to retain a preferred task and modifier combo, e.g hydras with a 150% drop rate increase for superior slayer drops. If the player is unsure of what modifier the task has, they may check their [[enchanted gem]], [[slayer ring]] (or [[Slayer ring (eternal)|eternal slayer ring]]) for the overall benefit. However if the player logs out, they will no longer be able to check the task's modifier. If looking for the exact modifier for clue scrolls, slayer experience or superior drop rate increase, they must head to a Slayer Master. Mortimer would have allowed players to choose their next Slayer task from another Slayer Master for a "hefty cost" of Slayer reward points, which was intended to bring traditional Slayer task-streaking in line with [[Turael#Task changing|Turael skipping]]. The ability to buy desired Slayer tasks was scrapped by Jagex due to it being too difficult to balance, along with feeling that it would only reinforce Turael skipping instead of offering an alternative.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/wyrmscraig---activities--lock-in-poll?oldschool=1|title=Wyrmscraig - Activities & Lock In Poll|newsdate=29 May 2026|quote=In Gnome's original design, Mortimer would have allowed players to directly choose any Slayer task in exchange for a large number of Slayer Points. Additionally, we feel the original design may also have negatively impacted the core identity of Slayer as a RNG-based task system and would have resulted in Turael boosting being even more meta than it is currently.}} Jagex's initial proposal required the following amount of Mortimer task completions to unlock each modifier. [[Steve]] resides in the [[Asgarnia Ice Dungeon]] and controls the upper level in the [[Skeletal Wyvern]] area until [[Monkey Madness II]] when he is replaced with his little sister [[Pieve]]. [[Slieve]] and [[Eve]] operate out of the [[Taverley Dungeon]], controlling the [[Black dragon|Black]] and [[Blue dragon]] areas, respectively. [[Captain Cleive]] controls access to the [[Lizardman shaman]] slayer caves. [[Lieve McCracken]] oversees [[Kraken Cove]]. [[Hieve]] runs a separate [[metal dragon]] area in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]], and is the older brother of Pieve and Steve. [[Weve]] guards the [[Wyvern Cave]] for on-task wyverns and [[ammonite crab]]s on [[Fossil Island]]. Nieve's uncle [[Breive]] maintains the [[Smoke Devil Dungeon]]. [[Weave]] guards the [[Morytania Spider Cave]] for access to [[araxyte]]s. [[Peeve]] guards specific sections of the [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]]. ====Family tree==== {{Family tree Nieve}} ===Monkey Madness II=== In [[Monkey Madness II]], she is recruited by the adventurer to stop [[Glough]] and his experiments from wreaking havoc after his airship crashed north of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. [[File:Monkey Madness II - Nieve dies.png|thumb|left|Nieve is killed by a collapsing boulder.]] After the [[10th Squad]] secures the Stronghold, she, along with the adventurer, pursues Glough in the [[Crash Site Cavern]], where she assists them in defeating Glough's tortured and [[demonic gorilla]]s. '''Spria''' is a [[Slayer master]] and daughter of [[Turael]]. She lives in a house in [[Draynor Village]] and assists the player with [[Sarah]]'s bounty during the quest [[A Porcine of Interest]].

After the quest, she acts as a Slayer master, assigning the same tasks as her father Turael, with the addition of being able to assign [[sourhog]]s. She is the only Slayer master who can assign them. However, she cannot change a Slayer task from another master into a less difficult one; she will instruct players to visit Turael to do so. Additionally, players cannot skip Spria's tasks using Turael. Completing a task assigned by her will always reward 0 points.

Blocking a task with Spria costs 40 [[Slayer reward point]]s and the block list is shared with [[Turael]]/[[Aya]].
